name: Gorilla Slop
summary:
# Introducing Gorilla Slop!

Jump into a sloppy and social multiplayer VR experience packed with fun game modes, extra slop and new friends to meet!

**Slime Tag** – Run if you can…but you cant hide forever.

**Murder Mystery** – Figure out who the murderer is…or dont get caught if its you.

**Casual Lobbies** – Relax, hang out  and meet other players.

Customize your gorilla in the **Gorilla Mall**, explore the world, and play your way.

There’s something for everyone in **Gorilla Slop**.
